# OneView

> OneView is a mobile app (iPhone and Android) that brings the stats of a creator's YouTube, TikTok and Instagram accounts into one place, and publishes one video to all three at once. Free plan; OneView Pro costs $4.99 a month, $49.99 a year or $79.99 once for life, with the first 7 days free for eligible new subscribers.

## TL;DR

- What: one app for the views, likes, comments and followers of YouTube, TikTok and Instagram accounts.
- Publishing: post one video to YouTube, TikTok and Instagram at once, with per-platform options (visibility, schedule, playlist, who can watch, TikTok inbox draft, Reel or Story) and a thumbnail picked from the video or the gallery.
- Charts: views, followers (gains in green, losses in red) or YouTube revenue, for all accounts together or each one.
- YouTube revenue: estimated earnings, RPM, CPM, monetized playbacks and ad impressions for the channel and each video (TikTok and Instagram don't share revenue).
- Analysis: one chart for every platform, goals per account with a predicted date, best time to post, top and flop content, words and hashtags that work, period comparisons, new post tracking for 48 hours.
- Comments: a YouTube tab and an Instagram tab, newest to oldest, with Unanswered, quick replies and bot detection. TikTok does not give apps access to comments.
- Extras: workspaces for several channels or clients, free weekly and monthly shareable reports, milestone notifications, Home Screen widgets on iPhone and Android.
- Privacy: sign-in on Google, TikTok and Meta's own pages; tokens and stats stay on the phone; nothing is sold; videos go straight from the phone to the platform.
- Not affiliated with YouTube, TikTok or Instagram; uses their official APIs.

## Plans

- Free ($0): 1 workspace; 1 YouTube, 1 TikTok and 1 Instagram account; combined stats for the last hour, 24 hours and 7 days; a page per account; YouTube revenue chart; weekly and monthly reports; milestone notifications.
- Pro ($4.99/month, $49.99/year or $79.99 once for life): everything in Free, plus publishing to all platforms, YouTube video editing and deletion, unlimited accounts and workspaces, 30-day and all-time stats, unlimited goals, insights, detailed analytics (including YouTube RPM and CPM), comparisons, new post tracking, comments, CSV export and widgets (views, followers or revenue). Bought in the app through the App Store or Google Play; cancel in the store's account settings.
